Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Both are better palaeographically. Remove extra space before PN in first correction.

Submit - l. 3 <:Ὡ̣ρπαρήους= PN N. Litinas|ed|Ἁ̣ρπαρήους:> l. 18 <:<:Ὡρπαρήους|reg|Ὁ̣ρπαρήους:>=PN N. Litinas|ed|Ἁρπαρήους:>
l. 3 Ἁ̣ρ̣παρήους - > Ὡ̣ρ̣παρήους; l. 18 Ἁρπαρήους -> Ὁρπαρήους <:Ὡρπαρήους|reg|Ὁ̣ρπαρήους:> . In l. 2 the first letter is not α, but we can see the two cups of an omega. In l. 18 the first letter cannot be α, because no other α is found in the same form in the same hand of the subscription. On the other hand cf. the form of ο with the joining stroke with the following letter, especially when in ypsilon follows. In l. 20 Τεφορσῶτος omicron is made circular. In any case the name Ἁρπάρης does not appear in any other document (TM NamVar 35380), while names beginning with Ωρπα-exist; cf. TM NamVar 3307, etc.
